name: SVC_BI_JOB_PROCESS_LISTS
description: This table is intended to be used for preparing the set of chunks for a parallel processing task.  Any number of lists may be created simultaneously in this table, and each list will be deleted upon completion of the task.  If the task is not successful, the associated list will be deleted after 24 hours.  The data created will be used by the dbms_parallel_execute.create_chunks_by_sql API to define the set of chunks.  This table is intended only for internal use, and the data should be considered to be temporary.

columns.name: JOB_PROCESS_LIST_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: LIST_ID
columns.description: Unique Id to distinguish lists from each other.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Id of an object to be sorted and grouped into chunks for parallel processing.  For example, an SR_ID.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: A sequential (ascending) order of the OBJECT_IDs within a list, starts with 1 and ends with the size of the list.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
